tools.name: list_contract_types
tools.description: List all contract and legal document types Pactlio can generate, with descriptions, use cases, and USD prices. Start here to find the right contract type slug/id for other tools.

tools.name: get_jurisdiction_requirements
tools.description: Statute-cited legal requirements, key differences, common pitfalls, terminology, and FAQs for a contract type in a specific US state or country. Use contract slug (e.g. "contractor-agreement") + jurisdiction slug (e.g. "california", "us", "uk", "eu-gdpr").

tools.name: check_non_compete_enforceability
tools.description: Whether a non-compete agreement is enforceable, limited, or void in a given US state (or DC), with salary thresholds and the key statute. Data covers all 50 states + DC.

tools.name: get_intake_questions
tools.description: The questions Pactlio asks to draft a specific contract type — use these to collect the information needed before calling start_contract_draft. Returns fields, types, options, and validation rules.

tools.name: start_contract_draft
tools.description: Prepare a contract draft with Pactlio's multi-agent AI engine (drafter, critic, compliance checker). Returns a preview_id and a URL. Generation (3-5 minutes) starts only when a human opens that URL in a browser — share it with your user, then poll get_draft_status. Free preview shows the opening sec

tools.name: get_draft_status
tools.description: Check a contract draft from start_contract_draft. Returns "awaiting_human" until a person opens the preview URL, "pending" while generating. When complete, returns the free preview (opening sections), the titles of locked sections, and the URL where a human can pay to unlock the full contract.

tools.name: get_checkout_link
tools.description: Returns the URL where a human can view the preview and pay to unlock the full contract for a draft created with start_contract_draft. Share this link with your user.

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "get_intake_questions" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: The questions Pactlio asks to draft a specific contract type — use these to collect the information needed before calling start_contract_draft. Returns fields, …

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_draft_status, get_checkout_link · Private data: list_contract_types · Public sink: start_contract_draft, get_checkout_link.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_draft_status, get_checkout_link · Private data: list_contract_types · Public sink: start_contract_draft, get_checkout_link

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "start_contract_draft" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
